svg.aria-label: Same hardware or new hardware decides the tool. pg_upgrade needs the same filesystem, link and clone modes especially. pg_dump and pg_restore, pgcopydb, and logical replication all work equally to new hardware, a different region, or a different cloud, since they go over the network. On managed clouds: RDS, Aurora, Cloud SQL and Azure Flexible Server offer true in-place upgrades; Aurora also offers Blue-Green Deployments, a managed version of the logical replication path in this post. Neon offers no in-place upgrade at all: every major-version move needs a new project.
